goal: Ensure wallet rescans detect transactions paying to look-ahead addresses when the pool-expanding transaction appears later in the same block
Prevent wallets from displaying an incorrect, underreported balance following a rescan or descriptor import
reviewability: Needs rebase against master following the merge of PR 34681
The author is also evaluating a proposed rewrite of the loop algorithm
agreement: Concept ACK on fixing the bug (achow101, molnard)
Reviewers demonstrated edge cases where the shrinking-prefix approach still misses transactions (molnard, jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a silent wallet balance underreporting bug during rescan and descriptor import without requiring a manual second rescan
Resolves intra-block ordering edge cases that directly impact user-visible wallet reliability

result.summary: Fixes a bug in ScanForWalletTransactions where transactions paying to addresses just outside the current look-ahead pool are missed if the pool-expanding transaction appears later in the same block's vtx order. The PR introduces a loop that re-scans the block prefix processed prior to the last pool expansion, and adds a functional test reproducing the failure across reload, importdescriptors, and cascading multi-expansion scenarios.
result.problem: When scanning a block in vtx order, an output to a key outside the current look-ahead pool is skipped as not-mine; if a subsequent transaction in the same block expands the pool via TopUp, the skipped transaction is not re-examined during that pass. This leaves the wallet with an underreported balance after rescan, descriptor import, or wallet load, with no warning to the user.

open_concerns: The prefix-only rescan does not revisit transactions located after the expansion point, missing child spends that spend recovered look-ahead outputs (molnard)
Cascaded receives occurring after the expansion position are also missed if they only become recognized after earlier look-ahead outputs are found (jeanpablojp)
An alternative loop that retries unmatched transactions until no new wallet transactions match was proposed and benchmarked to resolve both issues (jeanpablojp)
resolved_concerns: Double-firing of walletnotify on rescan passes was mitigated by bounding rescans to the prefix rather than rescanning the whole block (jeanpablojp)
Redundant checks were avoided by skipping range-end collection when SyncTransaction returns false (molnard)

result.card: This PR addresses a bug where ScanForWalletTransactions misses transactions to look-ahead keys if the pool-expanding transaction appears later in the same block, leaving wallet balances underreported after a rescan or descriptor import. The proposed patch re-scans the block prefix preceding the last pool expansion and adds extensive regression tests. Reviewers demonstrated edge cases where the prefix-only approach still leaves transactions or spends unrecorded, and suggested an alternative fixed-point retry loop. The PR currently needs a rebase following the merge of refactoring PR 34681.
